notes: Counting: claims_audited counts distinct assertions (prose sentences, list-item claims, table cells, embedded premises, worked-example steps, integration and integrity-note items). Each finding is one non-faithful line-level claim; a finding that covers two sub-claims on one line counts once, so faithful = claims_audited - findings. Quote check: every quoted span was compared mechanically against the deep ref and the converted source (normalising curly/straight and nested quotes), then mismatches were read by hand. All [V] quotes match the source word for word except D001 (bracket substitution) and D013 (truncation). Every [V] quote is present in the deep ref except line 119 (D028), which was re-extracted from the source. Several verbatim author quotes carry no marker (lines 14, 28, 32, 36, 46, 66, 84, 99), contrary to the distillation's own continuity statement. Converted source was consulted for quote checks and for the Wise Crowds, 15% Solutions, Troika, Agreement/Uncertainty Matrix, 25-to-10, After Action Debrief, Mini Constellations, Levels of Accountability, Appreciative Interviews, Storyboard and Q Storming sections. Other deep refs opened for integration claims: approach-perfect-field-guide-scrum-events-deep (thesis, Sprint Planning, Retrospective), scrum-guide-2020-deep (grep), lfuo-learning-review-guide-2024-deep (grep and Handout D; LFUO converted source grep for 'So What'), nhs-just-culture-guide-deep (lines 1-60 plus recommendations A-G), openstax-organizational-behavior-deep (headings, Ch 6.6, Ch 9.2, Ch 11), letaw-handbook-sweng-methods-deep (fist-of-five). These were targeted reads to check specific claims, not end-to-end reads. The Scrum/Field Guide row (line 161) and the NHS 'wider investigation on every branch' claim (line 163) check out: all seven NHS end-states carry a wider-investigation or wider-actions directive. Deep-ref gaps surfaced (cycling candidates, not distillation faults): the deep ref leaves out Troika's 'action planning' / 'ideas for next steps' framing (source 1572, 1603), the Agreement/Uncertainty Matrix instruction to map current work onto the diagram (source 1651), 25-to-10's 'Identify the top 10 high scores' (source 1705), and the Appreciative Interviews opener (source 1192). The 15% Solutions attribution split between handbook and Morgan is ambiguous in the source layout. Non-graded protocol observations: (1) the provenance stamp matches the current deep ref (sha256 f7d154e6...); (2) Key Concept 10 is anchored 'liberating-structures-methods', but concept-index.json already has '15-solutions'; (3) the Worked Example turns on the DAD closing questions but gives no [V] blockquote copied from the deep ref, as the projection protocol asks; (4) the borrowed-through list leaves out Marilee G. Adams (Q Storming, used at line 89), Appreciative Inquiry (line 119) and World Café (line 107), all [BT] in the deep ref; (5) the Relevance section names decision stages 'framing, exploring, deciding, committing', but the tables use six different phases (Framing, Bounding, Exploring, Deciding, Ratifying, Monitoring). Most consequential pattern: the surfacing-vs-committing taxonomy (D003, D023) is the distillation's own frame presented as the handbook's, and it contradicts itself on DADs and Troika.
